category_title: Unmotivated rising first graders with significant letter-sound recognition deficits and high interest in specific machinery
scenario_title: Initial oral reading assessment and attitude evaluation
minimal_context: Derek and his tutor are sitting in the Literacy Corner of a college library, where Derek is answering questions about his attitude toward reading and attempting to read a pre-primer word list.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start by talking about reading. Do you like to read for fun?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Umm, no. I like to play outside.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. What is your favorite book to read?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Don ’t have one. I like tractors though.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at this list of words on the paper. Try to read as many as you can out loud.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the list) I... (Stops and looks away) It’s not fun because I can ’t. No, that is never fun.

STUDENT: (Looks at the list) I... (Stops and looks away) It’s not fun because I can ’t. No, that is never fun.
